Subject: ISV market bundle & certification roadmap for DataForge (AWS listing + co-sell)

Hi Suresh,

Great talking yesterday — following up with a concise roadmap for getting the DataForge + Redwood bundle listed on AWS Marketplace and enabled for co-sell. I attached a first-pass SKU mapping and an evidence checklist to make the intake easier. High level ask: can you confirm the technical cert timeline and whether the DataForge legal team is ready to accept our co-sell terms (we've shared a standard MAA + reseller addendum previously)?

Key items for this week:
- Confirm the primary listing SKU and 2 demo SKUs (see redwood-df-sku-mapping-v1.xlsx).
- Delivery of a 3-pg security summary and SOC2 report snapshot (we need this for AWS review).
- Confirm lead internal for co-sell enablement (name + email).
- Flag any billing/usage model differences (metered vs. fixed) that will affect the listing.

Proposed timeline (aiming for AWS intake by end of Jan):
- Dec 18: finalize SKUs and evidence list
- Jan 08: submit intake to AWS Marketplace
- Jan 22: marketplace acceptance + co-sell enablement begins

Next steps from our side: Ben will prepare the co-sell enablement packet and Oli will validate technical evidence mappings. Vivek is tracking sales account alignment with our field.

If you can reply with the lead contact and confirm SOC2 availability by Friday, we’ll lock the Jan intake.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez

Alex —

Thanks for the clear kickoff note and the attachments. Quick answers:
- Primary contact for the listing is me (Suresh) and legal lead is Priya Rao (priya.rao@dataforge.io).
- SOC2 Type II report is current (Q3 2026) — I can share a redacted snapshot by EOD Friday.
- For SKUs: DataForge prefers a metered model (compute-based) but we can test a fixed monthly starter SKU for early co-sell deals.

We have a technical PM (Anita Shah) who can work with Oli to map evidence. She’s available for a short sprint next week (Dec 21–23).

One ask from our side: do you have a suggested co-sell revenue split template? Our legal team wants to see range examples before committing to the reseller addendum.

Suresh
VP Partnerships, DataForge
partner-dataforge@dataforge.io
+1 415 555 1234

Adding a few operational notes and an initial template.

Suresh / DataForge — attaching a working SKU-to-plan mapping (same file updated with notes). I put placeholder prices for the starter SKU and two metered tiers; pricing is intentionally conservative for initial co-sell to avoid sticker shock.

On co-sell splits: we typically propose a 70/30 revenue split (ISV/Redwood) on net revenue for sourced deals, with a different tier for joint-sourced opportunities. That’s a starting point — legal can adjust. I’ll add the revenue split examples to the HubSpot deal record (link below).

Action items for Redwood:
- Ollie (Olga) to validate evidence mapping and confirm whether our runtime telemetry can satisfy the metering usage reports.
- Vivek to map to field GTM: which Redwood AE/SE will be primary for co-sell handoffs.
- Alex to drive intake submission date with AWS.

DocuSign / next steps: I’ve created a draft reseller/MAA addendum and uploaded it as a DocuSign packet (https://docusign.com/packets/DF-2026-0091). If DataForge legal is OK, we can route for signature before intake.
